harness: PureChainReplayHarness; in-memory canonical fixture replay, not a production indexer

vectors.description: Two same-name Deploys in one block; lower original transaction index wins.
A later block cannot replace an existing canonical name winner.
A one-block replacement removes the old block state and applies the replacement block.
A genesis-height replacement assigns the name to the new canonical Deploy.
A Transfer in an orphaned block is removed and the sender balance returns.
A locator from an orphaned Deploy never aliases a transaction on the replacement chain.
Rollback old Transfers and replay the replacement branch from the common ancestor.
Direct replay of the replacement branch must equal rollback-then-replay.
